evidence.summary: Buyer proposals → normalized cash/loan, equipment, assumptions, warranty and exclusion fields → an apples-to-apples sign-or-question decision packet.

details.title: Solar Quote Decoder
details.buyer: U.S. homeowner holding two or more rooftop-solar/battery proposals
details.jtbd: normalize proposals before signing a high-value contract
details.raw_source_input: the buyer’s actual proposals plus DOE/CFPB/FTC decision criteria
details.transformation: extracts cash price, financed principal, cost per watt, production assumptions, equipment, warranties, exclusions and transfer terms into a comparable decision record
details.paid_value: independent reusable paper workspace that works with quotes from any installer, not lead-generation software
details.amazon_evidence: Exact Amazon query returned one tangential Kindle title; broader solar-buyer shelf showed 342 results. A May 2026 homeowner guide had 17 ratings and a June 2026 DIY guide had 167, showing recent entrant traction in the adjacent shelf.
details.external_evidence: DOE instructs buyers to compare quotes and cost per watt; CFPB documents hidden dealer fees and recommends comparing written proposals; EnergySage analyzes millions of shopper data points and reports active quote demand.
details.newcomer_evidence: MEDIUM-HIGH: recent adjacent entrant traction is visible, but exact-workbook traction is not yet observed.
details.commercial_differentiation: Buyer proposals → normalized cash/loan, equipment, assumptions, warranty and exclusion fields → an apples-to-apples sign-or-question decision packet.
details.free_alternative_pressure: HIGH but mostly fragmented guidance or marketplace-bound tools; the product is vendor-neutral and quote-owned.
details.main_risk: Exact book-intent demand may be smaller than the broader service/tool demand.

evidence.summary: Devis + official requirements → normalized scope/assumptions/gaps → questions before signature.

details.title: Heat Pump Quote Decoder France
details.buyer: French homeowner comparing PAC installation quotes
details.jtbd: normalize equipment, sizing, scope, aid and operating assumptions
details.raw_source_input: actual devis plus current official renovation rules
details.transformation: turns inconsistent quotes into comparable scope, assumptions and missing questions
details.paid_value: independent worksheet not tied to installer lead generation
details.amazon_evidence: Exact Amazon.fr books query returned no results.
details.external_evidence: French official aid and contractor rules demonstrate sequence-sensitive complexity; comparison services exist outside books.
details.newcomer_evidence: LOW: no direct entrant traction observed.
details.commercial_differentiation: Devis + official requirements → normalized scope/assumptions/gaps → questions before signature.
details.main_risk: Regulatory volatility and native French review.

evidence.summary: Seller claims + battery evidence + warranty → a confidence-graded inspection handoff.

details.title: Used EV Battery Evidence Checklist
details.jtbd: judge the quality of battery-health evidence before purchase
details.raw_source_input: seller evidence, vehicle reports, warranty terms and official battery guidance
details.transformation: separates observable evidence from model-specific claims and routes unresolved items to professional inspection
details.paid_value: portable pre-purchase evidence packet
details.amazon_evidence: Exact query showed 88 results and multiple 2026 titles, including a direct used-EV checklist and several low-review AI-like battery books; visible traction was weak.
details.external_evidence: Government literature recognizes battery-life uncertainty as a used-EV resale risk.
details.newcomer_evidence: LOW: direct recent competitors showed little visible traction.
details.commercial_differentiation: Seller claims + battery evidence + warranty → a confidence-graded inspection handoff.
details.main_risk: Model-specific expertise and tools are needed for trustworthy guidance.

evidence.summary: Nonstandard school offers → one normalized four-year cost/debt comparison → a documented family choice.

details.title: Financial Aid Offer Comparator
details.buyer: U.S. students and families holding multiple aid offers
details.jtbd: compare true net price, grant aid, work-study and borrowing
details.raw_source_input: actual school offers plus Federal Student Aid definitions
details.transformation: normalizes nonstandard offer letters and exposes four-year cost and debt assumptions
details.paid_value: writable family decision record independent of any school
details.amazon_evidence: Exact Amazon query returned one unrelated accounting book, not a purpose-built offer comparator.
details.external_evidence: Federal Student Aid explicitly says offers are nonstandard and teaches comparison by net price and debt.
details.newcomer_evidence: LOW: no direct newcomer traction observed.
details.commercial_differentiation: Nonstandard school offers → one normalized four-year cost/debt comparison → a documented family choice.
details.free_alternative_pressure: HIGH: strong official free guidance and calculators.
details.main_risk: Free official worksheet may satisfy most buyers.

evidence.summary: Visit evidence + public records + family priorities → a comparable facility shortlist and follow-up trail.

details.title: Assisted Living Visit & Decision Book
details.buyer: adult children comparing care facilities for a parent
details.jtbd: capture comparable observations, costs and follow-up across visits
details.raw_source_input: facility disclosures, visit observations and public inspection sources
details.transformation: separates observed facts, promises, unresolved questions and family priorities
details.paid_value: one calm shared decision record for a high-stress multi-person choice
details.amazon_evidence: Exact shelf contains a direct long-term-care comparison workbook at about EUR12.90 and adjacent guides; visible adjacent newcomer ratings were low single digits.
details.external_evidence: CMS and state regulators provide facility data, but family comparison remains fragmented across visits and websites.
details.commercial_differentiation: Visit evidence + public records + family priorities → a comparable facility shortlist and follow-up trail.
details.main_risk: Sensitive trust boundary and partial adjacency to Human Backup Plan.

evidence.summary: Inspection report → priority and specialist-question map → contingency decisions without pretending to price repairs.

details.title: Home Inspection Report Prioritizer
details.buyer: first-time homebuyer after receiving an inspection report
details.jtbd: separate negotiate-now, specialist-review, monitor and maintain items
details.raw_source_input: the buyer’s report plus standards-of-practice boundaries
details.transformation: converts report findings into questions, dependencies and decision categories without estimating repairs
details.paid_value: time-boxed decision layer during contingency
details.amazon_evidence: A 2015 authority guide showed 452 ratings; a direct February 2026 report-reading guide showed only one rating at about EUR11.18.
details.external_evidence: The job is time-sensitive and inspection reports explicitly require interpretation and specialist follow-up.
details.commercial_differentiation: Inspection report → priority and specialist-question map → contingency decisions without pretending to price repairs.

evidence.summary: Official rules → situation-first visual index → a ruling in under 20 seconds.

details.title: Padel Match-Situation Pocket Map
details.jtbd: settle recurring wall, serve, scoring and court situations during play
details.raw_source_input: current official federation rules
details.transformation: indexes rules by visible match situation rather than rulebook order
details.paid_value: fast courtside retrieval with diagrams
details.amazon_evidence: Padel For Dummies (July 2026) showed 9 ratings at about EUR21.50; a May 2026 beginner guide was about EUR13.88. Direct rules guide from 2024 showed one rating.
details.external_evidence: Official rules are free; participation growth and active clubs support the underlying job.
details.newcomer_evidence: MEDIUM: adjacent new entrant traction visible.
details.commercial_differentiation: Official rules → situation-first visual index → a ruling in under 20 seconds.
details.free_alternative_pressure: HIGH including official PDF and apps.
details.main_risk: A major publisher has entered and free phone retrieval may dominate.
